title: Getting Started Practice 1
statement:
Module 1 (Getting Started) covers: what is sql, select basics, filtering with where, sorting and limiting, creating tables, inserting data. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (What is SQL).
hints: Re-read the What is SQL lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
